how:
Whole-row floor pre-image test over the re-scored untouched failures (review D2, N-01/N-02). Read-only.
Identical test to scratchpad/hp-whr/whr_preimage.py (restore last_reported_ts to NULL on any subset of up to six of
the segment's state rows that carry a non-null value; a match with the FIRST anchored whole-row root shows that the
only change since sealing is last_reported_ts), applied to the untouched failures under the new counting rule of
floor_rescore.py (exp/out/<TAG>_floor_rescore.json). Also reports the bound for a stable-columns scheme (every
column except last_reported_ts): a reproduced segment would pass it; a late-row segment would fail it; the rest
cannot be decided from the final snapshot, because the anchored roots fold in last_reported_ts values that were
overwritten after sealing. Writes exp/out/<TAG>_floor_preimage_d2.json. Usage: d2_preimage.py TAG SNAPSHOT CHAIN
